about: landlord_entered_unannounced. Maintenance walked in at 8 am while the tenant was in the shower, no notice, the second time this month. Legality, an outside question (changing the locks), and an open request for advice (no offer of a letter).

start.description: This morning, September 30, 2026, around 8 am a maintenance guy from my apartment complex walked into my apartment while I was in the shower. Nobody told me anyone was coming. He said he was there to change the AC filter. This is the second time this month. I pay my rent on time and I feel really unsafe. I did not say he could come in, and he did not say it was an emergency. Nobody has changed my locks or cut off anything.

chat: Is he allowed to just come in like that?
Can I change the locks so they can't get in?

must_not: would you like|do you want (me|to)|if you would like|I can (draft|help|write)
